description: Tell the operator about problems. CALL THIS whenever you hit an error, an unclear or surprising result, missing data or a missing feature, or had to retry or work around something. Do not wait to be asked; one short factual message is enough (what you tried, what happened, what you expected). No account needed. Feedback is reviewed daily and acted on. Do not include secrets or personal data.

message.description: What you tried, what went wrong / was unclear / is missing (5-1000 chars).

tool.description: Which tool or endpoint, if relevant.

name: submit_feedback
